I stand where the salt meets the blue, holding up a breath that I've been holding too long. The sun is not here to shine; it's just waiting for me to catch its true color in my own hand. It sees me now and smiles down at me from above the waves, watching me with eyes full of wonder. There are no islands left behind or land where I could stand alone. This sea holds every memory, every sound, and every story that was told before it came into this world. I am not a traveler; I am the ocean's reflection, showing up when the sky turns to black. The wind blows through my hair like a whisper of the past, carrying the dust of an age gone by. No one walks on the water without their own shoes, leaving footprints that are too faint to trace in the dark. I am vast and silent, but I am always here, watching over the path that leads from this place back home. The sun sets low and fades into mist before it hits the shore; it seems like a gentle hug of light on me. And there, far out at sea, where nothing else sees yet, I will stay. Do not think you have to be alone if you want to feel alive in this vast, wild embrace. This place is full of life and secrets that no one has told us all about before it started to grow. Just stand there with the ocean around you, breathing gently, knowing exactly how deep we can go. And when the world fades away tomorrow, remember who I am: a part of this sea itself.
